transactions = []

    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Match patterns: "I owe X => $amount" or "X owes me => $amount"
    match = re.match(r'(?:I owe (\w+)|(\w+) owes me)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+)', line)

            amount = int(match.group(3))
            direction = 'pay'  # I need to pay them

            person = match.group(2)
            amount = int(match.group(3))
            direction = 'request'  # I need to request from them
        transactions.append({'person': person, 'amount': amount, 'direction': direction})
        print(f"Parsed: {person} - {amount} - {direction}")

print(f"\nTotal transactions: {len(transactions)}")
